name: Interior
_design: The house of somebody who reads the pass. Charts, a barometer and forty years of a weather book, and the last three weeks of it are in a different hand because they had to be checked twice.

text: A barometer in a case, and a book beside it with a column ruled for every day.
The needle is where it sits in October. The date at the top of the page is not October.
The last three weeks are written in somebody else’s hand, and each is initialled twice.
